newsitem.title: INDIA: India's oil imports seen rising by 10 pct in 97/98.
newsitem.headline: India's oil imports seen rising by 10 pct in 97/98.

text.p: India's imports of petroleum products are likely to increase by 10 percent in 1997/98 (April-March), a Bombay-based research firm said on Thursday.

"Import of petroleum products is likely to increase by about 10 percent from 33.5 million tonnes in 1995/96 to 37 million tonnes in 1997/98," the Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE) said in its March review of the economy.
CMIE said the government had estimated the oil import bill for 1997/98 at $10 billion. Crude oil imports were expected to remain steady at 33.5 million tonnes, it added.
